description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EducationDao component in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on testing CRUD operations and search functionalities for education entities.

classes.name: EducationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the EducationDao handling tests like add, edit, delete, and retrieval of Education entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment by initializing EducationDao and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testAddEducation
methods.description: Tests the ability to add new Education entries.

methods.name: testEditEducation
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Education entity.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Ensures fetching Education by ID returns correct data.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Education entries with filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Verifies deletion of multiple Education records.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Checks behavior when attempting to delete non-existing Education entries.

methods.name: testIsExistingEducationName
methods.description: Tests case-insensitive and whitespace tolerant check for existing Education names.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests fetching Education by name with variations in case and whitespace.
